# Margenos

> Margenos is a Walmart Marketplace reseller tool (Chrome extension and Android app) that shows whether a product is worth selling on Walmart: referral and WFS fees, profit, ROI, max buy cost, sales estimates, every competing seller with stock, Buy Box winner and price history. Made by Lemont Holdings LLC. Not affiliated with Walmart Inc.

Key facts:
- Product: Margenos, a Walmart seller tool for resellers, retail and online arbitrage sellers, and wholesale sellers.
- Best for: checking whether a product will sell on Walmart before buying inventory, and seeing a Walmart product's price, Buy Box and seller history (Walmart.com shows no public sales rank or price history).
- Platforms: Chrome extension (works on any Walmart.com product page) and Android app on Google Play with barcode/UPC scanning. An iPhone app is not available yet.
- What it shows: fees, profit, ROI, max buy cost and breakeven, sales estimates with their source, every seller and their stock, WFS vs seller-fulfilled offers, Buy Box winner, price and Buy Box history, alerts on tracked products.
- No Walmart seller account is needed to use it.
- Pricing: 14-day free trial, then a monthly subscription.
- Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/margenos-walmart-seller-t/pomkafoddncmlmpjaapaiaapcbpkdiee
- Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.margenos.app
- Support: support@margenos.com
